hero.name: Neeraj J
hero.bio: I'm a data engineer, software developer, and tech enthusiast with a Master’s in Data Science from Florida State University, passionate about bridging the gap between raw data and actionable insights. With expertise in machine learning, web development, data analytics, Python, SQL, AWS, and AI-powered solutions, I thrive on solving complex problems and building scalable, impactful applications. Beyond tech, I express creativity through cooking, dance, poetry, and shayaris, believing that the best innovations come from blending analytical thinking with artistic intuition. I enjoy working on big data processing, cloud computing, and predictive modeling to drive intelligent decision-making. Let’s connect and create something extraordinary! 🚀

experience.role: Center for Ocean and Atmospheric Prediction Studies
experience.description: At the Center for Ocean-Atmospheric Prediction Studies (COAPS) at Florida State University, I work as an Information Assistant and Data Analyst where I optimize data systems supporting oceanographic research. I redesigned vessel-position mapping workflows using SQL and Apache Spark, reducing query latency from several minutes to under 30 seconds. I also built automated ETL pipelines to process over 50,000 marine vessel records daily and supported multiple research web applications by containerizing services with Docker and improving data retrieval performance. My work helps scientists access reliable data and visualization tools for ongoing research.

At Datamorphosis, I worked as a Data Engineer building scalable data pipelines and analytics infrastructure. I developed PySpark ETL pipelines that ingested and transformed more than 500K records per processing cycle into AWS S3 and Snowflake, enabling efficient data storage and analysis. I orchestrated workflows using Apache Airflow, integrated AWS Glue transformations, and implemented Delta Lake for versioned data storage. Additionally, I supported experimentation workflows by modeling datasets in dbt and delivering insights through Tableau dashboards, while enforcing data governance with schema validation, RBAC policies, and CI/CD pipelines.

experience.company: Data Analyst and Team Lead Intern — Pune, India
experience.description: During my internship at Geniobits, I worked as a Data Analyst and Team Lead Intern focusing on educational analytics. I analyzed datasets of over 10,000 student records using PostgreSQL and exploratory data analysis techniques to identify students at risk academically. I developed Power BI dashboards with DAX to provide instructors with real-time insights into student performance and key academic KPIs. I also built a predictive model using PyTorch and statistical analysis in R that achieved an F1 score of 0.82, helping educators identify students who needed early academic intervention.
